raw: {"analysis":"JFW provides a more structured and complete delivery plan that addresses all repository facts: CI cost controls with explicit run budgets, proper handling of the 15% flaky notification check, the shared billing database constraint, and the staging gateway gap. CMF covers the core requirements but is less rigorous about CI cost management and doesn't explicitly cap pipeline runs despite the $45/run budget alert concern. Both handle the no-table-locks constraint and feature-flag rollback strategy similarly well."," "verdict": "JFW"}
